title: Operations Control Request 1.0
description: An admin request to change the operations kill-switch. It carries ONLY the desired deployment-wide and per-phase booleans plus the expected config_version the change is based on. It never carries identity, credential, principal, policy, or provider payload: the backend resolves the acting admin from the verified caller and enforces authority independently. The expected_config_version makes the change a compare-and-set so a stale write cannot clobber a newer document.

expected_config_version.description: The config_version the admin believes is current. The backend rejects the change if the stored document has moved on (compare-and-set).

desired_state.description: The complete desired boolean state. Only booleans: no identity, credential, or policy.
